name: tolerant-delete-arm-shape
body: Two limits on the tolerant arm. (1) It covers only the "absent on disk but still tracked in HEAD/index" shape — a file removed with `std::fs::remove_file` before the write set runs, relying on `commit_files`' tolerated `index.remove_path`. Add a sibling arm for an absent-and-untracked delete path (committed removal first) if that index tolerance ever becomes load-bearing rather than defensive. (2) The arm asserts the delta as exact `Modified`/`Deleted` lists, so a future third path in the same write set fails loudly; broaden the filter when the tolerant mutation legitimately grows another path.
